sentences.text: Several rooms stayed below 18.0 °C throughout the night, including the parents' room, which reached 16.4 °C at 05:20.
The bathroom also registered a low of 16.8 °C at 05:00.
Please remember that the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Since multiple rooms were below 18.0 °C, perhaps checking the heating would be helpful.
